item.text: I’ll trace the v27 movement decode path and its callers, then make the smallest version-scoped fix. I’ll inspect existing tests but won’t run any unless you ask.

The decoder is isolated to `rd-protocol` and currently uses nearest-integer rounding. For negative fractional positions such as `-63/32`, that produces `-2`; truncating integer division produces the requested `-1` (toward zero) without affecting exact coordinates. I’m adding that regression case alongside the one-line fix.

One compatibility detail matters: replacing the conversion wholesale would also change positive fractional coordinates. I’m preserving the existing nearest rounding for nonnegative values and applying truncation only on the negative path, matching the requested scope.

Fixed the v27 movement decoder:

- Negative fractional coordinates now truncate toward zero (`-63 → -1`).
- Positive rounding behavior remains unchanged (`63 → 2`).
- Added regression coverage.
- `git diff --check` passes.

Tests weren’t run per project instructions.
